description.zh: 箭头与分量、首尾相接的向量加法、数乘与减法、点积与投影，并用绳子受力平衡和过河的相对速度两个例子应用。二维直角坐标。
description.en: Arrows and components, head-to-tail vector addition, scaling and subtraction, the dot product and projection, applied to rope-force equilibrium and relative velocity when crossing a river. Two-dimensional Cartesian coordinates.
